reel.caption:
Left ₹1,000 unpaid on your card bill? Your new buys now pay interest.

If the full bill isn't paid by the due date, the interest-free period is lost, even on a small leftover amount.
New purchases then attract interest too, until the whole balance is cleared.
Illustrative: ₹20,000 of new spending at 3% a month = ₹600 a month, plus 18% GST (₹108) on that interest.
Paying only the minimum due avoids the late fee, not this interest.

Did you know a small leftover balance switches off your free days?
Send this to the friend who pays "almost all" of the bill.

Sources: a personal-finance magazine's explainer on interest-free days; a comparison site's guide to the card grace period. Card rates vary by issuer; figures are illustrative.

For education only. Not investment advice.
